rationale: The short thesis is mechanically intact — price sits at the low of day below VWAP (13.60) and the 9-EMA, the risk-off tape (SPY -0.79%, VIXY +2.92%) is unchanged, and the invalidation at 13.61 has not been touched. The 7-minute stall at 13.57 shows a persistent bid absorbing ~96k shares, which is a yellow flag, but there is no reclaim of VWAP or reversal structure, and holding keeps risk small (~$44 to the stop) against a ~3.7:1 payoff toward the 13.42 gap-fill target. Flipping long would mean buying the LOD of a heavily distributed name against the tape, which is not supported by stronger evidence than simply staying flat-to-short.
